b.what: keep the HRA uterus and vagina and her scanned bladder, relax them into the Wu pelvic floor
b.verdict: the HRA vagina lies where the Wu urethra and its sphincter are; relaxing it into the floor means moving it to where the Wu vagina already is

a.what: Wu vagina, urethra and anorectum as they are; uterus and adnexa either HRA (joined at the cervix) or Wu's own
a.chosen: Wu uterus, tubes, ovaries and round ligaments
a.why: the Wu uterus is continuous with the Wu vagina (one reconstruction of one woman); the HRA uterus would have to be moved by the distance given under lowerEndToTopOfWuVaginaMm and reshaped at the fornix to meet it, and its ovaries are a tenth of the volume of real ones. The HRA ligaments and uterine vessels, which Wu lacks, are kept and carried to the Wu organs.

wuOverlaps.method: vertices sunk into a higher-priority structure (taken as a filled body) move just beyond the nearest point of its surface (0.5 mm clearance, at most 8 mm); order = WU_PRIORITY

bladder.method: her scanned bladder kept for size and dome; the point of its wall nearest the top of the Wu urethra pulled onto it, and the point of its base nearest the Wu vagina drawn to 2 mm from the anterior vaginal wall, by Gaussian fields (σ 12 mm), the volume restored by a uniform scaling about the apex of the dome (three rounds); wall then slid out of Wu structures (1 mm gap)

hraLigaments.method: smooth field from the correspondences HRA organ → Wu organ (uterus: similarity ICP; ovaries, tubes, vagina: centroid and volume) with the pelvic bones held fixed; then slid out of Wu organs, bladder and bone (≤ 15 mm); dropped unless ≤ 5 % of the surface is inside a solid, the part comes within 6 mm of the organ it belongs to and its area changed by less than 2.5×; of a pair both sides are dropped when one fails

parts.reason: its twin on the other side failed
its twin on the other side failed

rectosigmoid.method: Gaussian translation field centred on the lower end of the warped sigmoid colon (σ = max(30 mm, 0.8 × shift)), applied to all warped bowel and the vessels and nodes hanging on it

bowel.method: the bowel is a closed tube: it is shifted as a whole by Gaussian translation fields centred on the organ it contains (direction and size chosen to clear the organ at least cost), never by pushing its surface

warpedDropped.rule: more than 20 % of the surface still inside Wu organs or the bladder after the slide-out (and its twin of the other side)

caution.en: The skin was fitted to enclose muscles, bones, cartilages and organs only. Fasciae, cutaneous nerves and superficial vessels lying on them were not considered, and 1.4% of their surface comes through the skin, by up to 6 mm (medial sural cutaneous nerve). Surface parts made for the earlier skin do not sit on this one: pubic hair, eyebrow, perionyx (foot), nail plate (foot), hair of head, nail plate, perionyx.
caution.zh: 皮肤拟合时只保证包住肌、骨、软骨和器官，贴在它们外面的筋膜、皮神经和浅血管没有考虑：这些结构的表面有 1.4% 露在皮肤之外，最多 6 mm。为旧皮肤制作的体表部件（头发、眉、外耳、甲、阴毛等）与这层皮肤对不上。

cautions.en: This is a constructed standard female, not a scan of one person. Bones, leg and pelvis muscles and some organs come from one donor (Visible Human Female: CT and the University of Denver cryosection models, 184 parts), but they were re-posed and then scaled segment by segment to the proportions of an average young woman (stature 160.6 cm), so no part keeps the donor's true size or proportions; all are labelled "warped". The other 3101 parts are male anatomy deformed onto that skeleton.
cautions.zh: 本模型是构建出来的“标准女性”，并非某一位女性的扫描。骨骼、下肢和骨盆的肌以及部分器官来自同一位供体（Visible Human Female：CT 和丹佛大学的冰冻切片模型，共 184 个部件），但都重新摆过姿势，并逐肢段缩放到年轻女性的平均比例（身高 160.6 cm），因此没有任何部件保留供体的真实大小和比例，一律标为“形变”。其余 3101 个部件是形变贴合到这副骨架上的男性结构。

cautions.en: Proportions are imposed, not measured: segment lengths follow regressions fitted to US Army and US civilian surveys, evaluated at the mean stature of Chinese women aged 20–24. The trunk was shortened, the shoulder girdle lowered by about 7 cm, the forearms and lower legs lengthened, the pelvis narrowed by about 11 % and the feet flattened by about 20 %; the muscle envelope of the arms, chest wall, thighs and calves was thinned to fit the girths of a woman of BMI 21.6. Do not read individual bone shape, joint congruency or muscle bulk from this model.
cautions.zh: 比例是设定的，不是测得的：各肢段长度按美国陆军和美国平民测量数据拟合的回归式取值，身高取中国 20–24 岁女性的均值。躯干被缩短，肩带下移约 7 cm，前臂和小腿被加长，骨盆收窄约 11 %，足被压低约 20 %；上肢、胸壁、大腿和小腿的肌肉包络被收薄，以符合 BMI 21.6 女性的围度。不要据此模型判断单块骨的形状、关节的吻合程度或肌肉的粗细。

cautions.en: Most leg and pelvis muscles are spliced: the belly is the donor's (Denver cryosection model, bellies only) and the tendons are cut from the male muscle and moved to meet it, so the junction between belly and tendon is a join, not anatomy. Where no clean join was possible (gastrocnemius, gracilis, sartorius, semimembranosus, semitendinosus, gluteus minimus) the male muscle is shown instead. Vessels and nerves of the leg are male structures pushed out of these muscles afterwards; some still run through them.
cautions.zh: 下肢和骨盆的肌大多是拼接的：肌腹来自供体（Denver 冰冻切片模型，只有肌腹），肌腱则取自男性的同名肌并移到与肌腹对齐，所以肌腹与肌腱的交界是拼接出来的，不是真实解剖。无法干净拼接的肌（腓肠肌、股薄肌、缝匠肌、半膜肌、半腱肌、臀小肌）仍用男性的肌。下肢的血管和神经是男性结构，事后被推出这些肌之外，仍有一部分从肌中穿过。

cautions.en: Warped parts are anchored by bone only. Between bones their position is extrapolated: expect errors of 1–3 cm for limb muscles, vessels and nerves, and more in the abdomen and pelvis.
cautions.zh: 形变部件仅以骨骼为锚点，骨与骨之间的位置靠外推得到：四肢的肌肉、血管和神经误差约 1–3 cm，腹部和盆腔更大。

cautions.en: The pelvic floor, the anal and urethral sphincters, the perineal muscles, clitoris and vestibular bulbs, the urethra, vagina, rectum and anal canal, uterus, tubes and ovaries (51 parts) are real female anatomy, but of ANOTHER woman, not of the donor of the skeleton (Wu et al. 2015: a young adult of the Chinese Visible Human series). Her structures were reconstructed from cryosections and smoothed by the authors of that study, enlarged 1.096 times and fitted to this pelvis by its bones (to about 2 mm), then narrowed by 11 % together with the pelvis. Left and right halves were separated by this project, and where neighbouring structures overlapped the less important one was reshaped by up to 8 mm. Do not read sizes, exact positions or left–right differences from these parts.
cautions.zh: 盆底肌、肛门括约肌和尿道括约肌、会阴肌、阴蒂和前庭球、尿道、阴道、直肠和肛管、子宫、输卵管和卵巢（共 51 个部件）是真实的女性解剖结构，但来自另一位女性，不是这副骨架的供体（Wu 等 2015 年的研究：中国可视化人体数据集中的一位年轻成年女性）。这些结构由该研究的作者根据冰冻切片重建并做过平滑，本模型把它们放大 1.096 倍，按骨性标志配准到这个骨盆上（误差约 2 mm），又随骨盆一起横向收窄 11 %。左右两半是本项目切分的；相邻结构有重叠的地方，次要的一方被重新塑形，最多移动 8 mm。不要据此判断这些结构的大小、精确位置或左右差异。

cautions.en: Three sources meet in the lesser pelvis, and where they meet the model is a join, not anatomy. The bladder, bones and obturator internus are the donor's; her bladder is almost empty (35.7 ml), its neck was drawn 12.1 mm onto the upper end of the other woman's urethra and its base 13 mm back onto the anterior vaginal wall. The uterus stands as it did in the other woman, whose bladder was full, so an unnatural gap remains between bladder and uterus. The sigmoid colon, ureters, vessels, nerves and lymph nodes are male structures: the end of the sigmoid colon was moved 20.2 mm to meet the upper end of the rectum (which is cut off at the top of the specimen), the bowel was shifted by up to 32 mm to clear the uterus, left tube and left ovary, and vessels that ran through these organs were pushed to their surface; some still cut through them. Uterine artery, Uterine vein, Mesovarium, Suspensory ligament of ovary, Uterovesical pouch are artist models (Human Reference Atlas) moved 2–4 cm onto these organs.
cautions.zh: 小骨盆里有三个来源的结构，它们相接的地方是拼接出来的，不是真实解剖。膀胱、骨和闭孔内肌来自骨架的供体；她的膀胱几乎是空的（35.7 ml），膀胱颈被拉动 12.1 mm 接到另一位女性的尿道上端，膀胱底向后移了 13 mm 贴近阴道前壁。子宫保持它在另一位女性体内的位置，而那位女性的膀胱是充盈的，所以膀胱与子宫之间留有一段不自然的空隙。乙状结肠、输尿管、血管、神经和淋巴结是男性结构：乙状结肠末端被移动 20.2 mm 去对接直肠上端（直肠在标本上缘处被截断），肠管整体移动了最多 32 mm 以避开子宫、左输卵管和左卵巢，原本穿过这些器官的血管被推到器官表面，仍有少数从中穿过。子宫动脉、子宫静脉、卵巢系膜、卵巢悬韧带、膀胱子宫陷凹是美术建模（Human Reference Atlas），被移动 2–4 cm 贴到这些器官上。

cautions.en: The body surface is a parametric model skin (Momentum Human Rig (MHR) v1.0.1), not a scan and not her own skin: a surface shaped as a standard female body and then relaxed outwards over her muscles until it encloses them. It is heavier than intended: BMI 23.65 by enclosed volume against a target of 21.6. The shoulders and upper arms are fuller than the target (bideltoid breadth 467 mm against 443 mm). Under the right arm the skin of the axilla runs into the skin of the trunk (about 33 cm² between 25 % and 40 % of the length of the humerus). The toes are one block, and the perineum is a smooth surface without vulvar anatomy.
cautions.zh: 体表是参数化模型皮肤（Momentum Human Rig (MHR) v1.0.1），不是扫描所得，也不是她本人的皮肤：先做成标准女性体形的表面，再向外松弛到把她的肌肉包住。它比设定的要胖：按所围体积算 BMI 为 23.65，目标是 21.6。肩部和上臂比目标粗（两侧三角肌间宽 467 mm，目标 443 mm）。右腋窝处上臂内侧的皮肤穿入了躯干的皮肤（肱骨长度 25–40 % 处约 33 cm²）。足趾连成一块；会阴是一片光滑的表面，没有外阴的解剖结构。

cautions.en: Her head is the skin model's average head scaled to her skull, not a face of her own; the surface there has faults of its own: horizontal steps across the face at the level of the nose, the mouth and the chin, a crumpled knot of skin at the inner corner of each eye and a rough rim round the nostrils. The soft tissue of the lower face is too thick (about 15 mm of cover over orbicularis oris). The model's eyes sit about 5 mm further from the midline on each side than her eyeballs. The eyes and the mouth are not openings: the lids are one sheet of skin over the globe and the lips meet in a crease; there the skin was deliberately not pushed out, and what lies under it comes through: the inner (palpebral) ring of orbicularis oculi by up to 2.1 mm. The face keeps the full resolution of the surface (15987 vertices, mean edge 1.88 mm); the rest of the skin is simplified.
cautions.zh: 她的头是皮肤模型的平均头按她的颅骨缩放得到的，不是她本人的面孔；这块表面自身也有毛病：面部在鼻、口、颏的高度各有一道横向的台阶，两眼内眦处各有一团皱起的皮肤，鼻孔缘粗糙。下面部的软组织偏厚（口轮匝肌外约有 15 mm 的覆盖）。模型的眼比她的眼球每侧偏外约 5 mm。眼和口都不是开口：眼睑是盖在眼球前的一整片皮肤，上下唇在口裂处相贴成一道褶；这些地方的皮肤有意不外推，因此有结构露出皮肤：眼轮匝肌内环（睑部）最多 2.1 mm。面部保留体表的原始分辨率（15987 个顶点，平均边长 1.88 mm），其余皮肤经过简化。

cautions.en: The breasts on the surface are the skin model's. The gland, ducts, fat, areola and nipple inside them are an artist model (Human Reference Atlas) of a larger breast in standing shape, scaled to 0.41 (left) and 0.52 (right) of its size and moved about 7 cm down to fit under that skin. They sit too low: the centre of the gland is 31 and 26 mm below the lower border of the sternocostal part of pectoralis major (it lies over the abdominal part of the muscle only), and the nipple about 7 cm below the tip of the xiphoid process. Their size, their place on the chest wall and the difference between left and right are therefore not anatomical data.
cautions.zh: 体表上的乳房是皮肤模型的。其内的腺体、导管、脂肪、乳晕和乳头是美术模型（Human Reference Atlas），原本是更大的站立位乳房，被缩小到原大小的 0.41（左）和 0.52（右），并下移约 7 cm，才放得进这层皮肤。它们的位置偏低：腺体中心在胸大肌胸肋部下缘以下 31 和 26 mm（只盖在该肌的腹部之上）；乳头在剑突尖以下约 7 cm。因此它们的大小、在胸壁上的位置和左右差别都不是解剖数据。

cautions.en: The skin was fitted to enclose muscles, bones, cartilages and organs only. Fasciae, cutaneous nerves and superficial vessels lying on them were not considered, and 1.4% of their surface comes through the skin, by up to 6 mm (medial sural cutaneous nerve). Surface parts made for the earlier skin do not sit on this one: pubic hair, eyebrow, perionyx (foot), nail plate (foot), hair of head, nail plate, perionyx.
cautions.zh: 皮肤拟合时只保证包住肌、骨、软骨和器官，贴在它们外面的筋膜、皮神经和浅血管没有考虑：这些结构的表面有 1.4% 露在皮肤之外，最多 6 mm。为旧皮肤制作的体表部件（头发、眉、外耳、甲、阴毛等）与这层皮肤对不上。

cautions.en: Muscle bulk and position were then changed again to fit a target body surface: a parametric female skin (stature 160.6 cm, BMI 21.6) less the subcutaneous fat expected at each place. Muscles, tendons, warped organs, vessels and nerves were pushed in, and in places pulled out, by up to 29 mm with one smooth field that is zero on bone; 69 muscles lost more than a quarter of their volume (calf, abdominal wall, forearm extensors, neck). 12 % of the muscle and organ surface still lies outside that target, mostly thin muscle lying directly on bone. Muscle thickness, cross-section and volume in this model are therefore not anatomical data.
cautions.zh: 之后又按一个目标体表改动了肌肉的粗细和位置：目标是参数化的女性皮肤（身高 160.6 cm，BMI 21.6）向内减去各处应有的皮下脂肪。肌、腱、形变来的器官、血管和神经被一个在骨面上为零的平滑位移场推入（个别地方拉出），最多 29 mm；69 块肌的体积减少了四分之一以上（小腿、腹壁、前臂伸肌、颈部）。仍有 12 % 的肌和器官表面在目标之外，主要是直接贴在骨上的薄肌。因此本模型中肌肉的厚度、横截面和体积都不是解剖数据。
皮下脂肪层是在上述合成体表与她的肌肉、骨骼、器官外包络之间按 3 mm 体素填充得到的（最深只算到皮下 3 cm），并非扫描所得；其厚度取决于合成的皮肤，不代表女性真实的脂肪分布。
cautions.en: The subcutaneous fat layer fills the gap between that synthetic body surface and the outer envelope of her muscles, bones and organs at 3 mm voxels (no deeper than 3 cm below the skin); it is not scanned, and its thickness follows the synthetic skin rather than a real female fat distribution.

Absent from the pelvis: labia, vestibule and the skin of the vulva (the body surface there is smooth); the mucosa and lumen of the urethra; broad ligament of uterus, cardinal ligament, uterosacral ligament, mesosalpinx, ovarian ligament (the artist models of these did not fit the organs shown and were left out); ovarian and vaginal vessels; the autonomic pelvic plexuses. The iliococcygeus is not a separate part: the source describes the pubococcygeus and iliococcygeus together as a "pubovisceral muscle" with an inner and an external layer. Male-only parts (prostate, testes, penis, seminal vesicles, testicular vessels, male urethra) and the male pelvic floor and rectum were removed, as were male structures that would lie inside the female organs (postvesical nodes).
cautions.zh: 盆腔中缺失的结构：阴唇、阴道前庭和外阴皮肤（该处的体表是光滑的）；尿道的黏膜和管腔；子宫阔韧带、主韧带、骶子宫韧带、输卵管系膜、卵巢固有韧带（这些结构的美术模型与这里显示的器官对不上，没有采用）；卵巢血管和阴道血管；盆腔自主神经丛。髂尾肌不是单独的部件：数据来源把耻尾肌和髂尾肌合称“耻骨内脏肌”，分为内层和外层。男性特有结构（前列腺、睾丸、阴茎、精囊、睾丸血管、男性尿道）以及男性的盆底肌和直肠已删除，落在女性器官内部的男性结构（postvesical nodes）也已删除。

cautions.en: Pose is reconstructed: the donor was scanned lying down with bent elbows and pointed feet, and each bone was moved rigidly into a standing pose. Joint spaces at the elbow, knee, ankle and shoulder are approximate, and the scapulae and clavicles keep their lying-down position.
cautions.zh: 姿势是重建的：供体扫描时为仰卧、屈肘、足跖屈，各骨被逐一刚性移动到站立姿势。肘、膝、踝、肩的关节间隙只是近似，肩胛骨和锁骨仍保持仰卧时的位置。

cautions.en: Right radius, ulna and the bones of both hands and feet are not her scanned bones: the right forearm is a mirrored copy of the left (the scan cut it off), and hand and foot bones are warped male bones with extended fingers.
cautions.zh: 右侧桡骨、尺骨以及双手、双足的骨并非她的扫描骨：右前臂是左前臂的镜像（扫描视野将其截断），手骨和足骨是形变后的男性骨，手指呈伸直状。

cautions.en: The donor had six lumbar vertebrae. A standard five-lumbar spine is shown: her first lumbar vertebra was removed and everything above it moved down by one segment, so the thoracolumbar junction is a join, not anatomy. Rib numbering comes from automatic segmentation and is unreliable for left ribs 5–9.
cautions.zh: 供体有六节腰椎。这里显示的是标准的五节腰椎：去掉了她的第一腰椎，其上方的全部结构下移一个椎节，因此胸腰交界处是拼接出来的，不是真实解剖。肋骨编号来自自动分割，左侧第 5–9 肋的编号不可靠。

cautions.en: Her scanned organs (kidneys, spleen, pancreas, adrenals, gallbladder, bladder, gluteal muscles) are in lying-down, post-mortem position and do not always meet the warped vessels and ducts that should connect to them. Lungs, heart, liver, stomach and bowel are warped male organs.
cautions.zh: 她的扫描器官（肾、脾、胰、肾上腺、胆囊、膀胱、臀肌）处于仰卧、死后的位置，与本应相连的形变血管和管道不一定对得上。肺、心、肝、胃和肠是形变后的男性器官。

cautions.en: Everything said about the male model also applies to the warped parts: nerves, ligaments and lymph nodes are artist-modelled with schematic nerve thickness; phrenic nerve, pleura, pericardium, spinal cord, menisci and cruciate ligaments are absent.
cautions.zh: 男性模型的各项注意事项同样适用于形变部件：神经、韧带和淋巴结为美术建模，神经粗细仅为示意；膈神经、胸膜、心包、脊髓、半月板和交叉韧带缺失。

Her head is the skin model's average head scaled to her skull, not a face of her own; the surface there has faults of its own: horizontal steps across the face at the level of the nose, the mouth and the chin, a crumpled knot of skin at the inner corner of each eye and a rough rim round the nostrils. The soft tissue of the lower face is too thick (about 15 mm of cover over orbicularis oris). The model's eyes sit about 5 mm further from the midline on each side than her eyeballs. The eyes and the mouth are not openings: the lids are one sheet of skin over the globe and the lips meet in a crease; there the skin was deliberately not pushed out, and what lies under it comes through: the inner (palpebral) ring of orbicularis oculi by up to 2.1 mm. The face keeps the full resolution of the surface (15987 vertices, mean edge 1.88 mm); the rest of the skin is simplified.

The breasts on the surface are the skin model's. The gland, ducts, fat, areola and nipple inside them are an artist model (Human Reference Atlas) of a larger breast in standing shape, scaled to 0.41 (left) and 0.52 (right) of its size and moved about 7 cm down to fit under that skin. They sit too low: the centre of the gland is 31 and 26 mm below the lower border of the sternocostal part of pectoralis major (it lies over the abdominal part of the muscle only), and the nipple about 7 cm below the tip of the xiphoid process. Their size, their place on the chest wall and the difference between left and right are therefore not anatomical data.

The skin was fitted to enclose muscles, bones, cartilages and organs only. Fasciae, cutaneous nerves and superficial vessels lying on them were not considered, and 1.4% of their surface comes through the skin, by up to 6 mm (medial sural cutaneous nerve). Surface parts made for the earlier skin do not sit on this one: pubic hair, eyebrow, perionyx (foot), nail plate (foot), hair of head, nail plate, perionyx.

Muscle bulk and position were then changed again to fit a target body surface: a parametric female skin (stature 160.6 cm, BMI 21.6) less the subcutaneous fat expected at each place. Muscles, tendons, warped organs, vessels and nerves were pushed in, and in places pulled out, by up to 29 mm with one smooth field that is zero on bone; 69 muscles lost more than a quarter of their volume (calf, abdominal wall, forearm extensors, neck). 12 % of the muscle and organ surface still lies outside that target, mostly thin muscle lying directly on bone. Muscle thickness, cross-section and volume in this model are therefore not anatomical data.

The subcutaneous fat layer fills the gap between that synthetic body surface and the outer envelope of her muscles, bones and organs at 3 mm voxels (no deeper than 3 cm below the skin); it is not scanned, and its thickness follows the synthetic skin rather than a real female fat distribution.

Absent from the pelvis: labia, vestibule and the skin of the vulva (the body surface there is smooth); the mucosa and lumen of the urethra; broad ligament of uterus, cardinal ligament, uterosacral ligament, mesosalpinx, ovarian ligament (the artist models of these did not fit the organs shown and were left out); ovarian and vaginal vessels; the autonomic pelvic plexuses. The iliococcygeus is not a separate part: the source describes the pubococcygeus and iliococcygeus together as a "pubovisceral muscle" with an inner and an external layer. Male-only parts (prostate, testes, penis, seminal vesicles, testicular vessels, male urethra) and the male pelvic floor and rectum were removed, as were male structures that would lie inside the female organs (postvesical nodes).

Pose is reconstructed: the donor was scanned lying down with bent elbows and pointed feet, and each bone was moved rigidly into a standing pose. Joint spaces at the elbow, knee, ankle and shoulder are approximate, and the scapulae and clavicles keep their lying-down position.

Right radius, ulna and the bones of both hands and feet are not her scanned bones: the right forearm is a mirrored copy of the left (the scan cut it off), and hand and foot bones are warped male bones with extended fingers.

The donor had six lumbar vertebrae. A standard five-lumbar spine is shown: her first lumbar vertebra was removed and everything above it moved down by one segment, so the thoracolumbar junction is a join, not anatomy. Rib numbering comes from automatic segmentation and is unreliable for left ribs 5–9.

Her scanned organs (kidneys, spleen, pancreas, adrenals, gallbladder, bladder, gluteal muscles) are in lying-down, post-mortem position and do not always meet the warped vessels and ducts that should connect to them. Lungs, heart, liver, stomach and bowel are warped male organs.

Everything said about the male model also applies to the warped parts: nerves, ligaments and lymph nodes are artist-modelled with schematic nerve thickness; phrenic nerve, pleura, pericardium, spinal cord, menisci and cruciate ligaments are absent.
